headline: 影剧双热：《最后的曙光》登顶，《绿灯军团》霸榜
headlineEn: Movies & TV: 'The Last Dawn' tops, 'Green Lantern Corps' dominates
summary: 今日零新片上映，本周8部新片待映。电影《最后的曙光》今日热度第一，剧集《绿灯军团》《侠探杰克》持续霸榜，Ted Lasso也受追捧。
summaryEn: No movies opened today; 8 new movies are set for this week. Film 'The Last Dawn' tops today's heat, while series 'Green Lantern Corps' and 'Reacher' keep dominating, with Ted Lasso also drawing attention.

industryHighlights.text: 《最后的曙光》登顶今日电影热搜。
